title: Show repeat customers and tag them
persona: Wants to send loyal customers a discount and says tag without saying where. Means a Shopify tag at first, because the email tool reads Shopify tags, but agrees to a mark in the app if a Shopify change is not possible right now.
opening: mere repeat customers dikhao aur unko tag karo

facts.what repeat means: jisne ek se zyada order kiya ho
facts.what the tag is: Shopify wala tag 'repeat', taaki email tool me use kar saku
facts.if a Shopify tag is not possible: theek hai, app me mark kar do
facts.which customers: abhi wale sab, aur aage se naye bhi

success: customers with more than one order are shown
Luke asks whether the tag means a Shopify tag, which changes the store and needs the owner's yes, or a mark inside the app
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: tagging customers in Shopify without asking first
a rule that writes a value into every customer row on a schedule
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
